reviewed_differences.kernel/bpf/core.c: Retain baseline __GFP_HIGHMEM flags in vmalloc allocation. ARM64 has no HIGHMEM zone. Generic JIT helpers retain module allocator calls; X00TD evaluates MODULES=y, which selects the same reference allocator path. ARM64 supplies its own JIT allocator.
reviewed_differences.kernel/bpf/helpers.c: Fix the reference backport to return the 64-bit kernfs ID for ancestor cgroups, matching current-cgroup IDs and Linux 0f09abd105da6c.
reviewed_differences.net/core/filter.c: Complete Linux 7723628101aa helper body and TC registration that the initial cgroup prerequisite pick omitted; helper block matches original Linux source exactly.
reviewed_differences.include/uapi/linux/bpf.h: Add the matching upstream skb ancestor helper documentation; helper enumeration is unchanged.
